intro: Some scores are harder to read. Here's how to help Partsong with them.
open: This carol changes layout: four staves for the first verse, and two for the last. Open it, and tap Read music.
systems: First, check the red lines. Each one marks where a line of music ends.
remove: Here, Partsong has split one line of music in two. Tap the red line to remove it.
add: And here, two lines of music have run together. Tap between them to add a red line.
next: Then tap Next, and Partsong reads the notes.
parts: Because the layout changes, the list of parts doesn't make sense. So mark your part on the music instead.
mark: Tap the staff you sing in each line of music. I'm an alto.
shared: Where two voices share a staff, tap once for the upper voice, and twice for the lower.
play: Tap Done, then play. Partsong plays exactly what you marked.
end: Partsong. Free on your iPhone, Android and desktop.
